message: Preregistered tiny, small, medium and large dynamics capacity on the mixture selected by the frozen CR-DYN-0008 rule.
Froze the selected-mixture scale runner before CR-DYN-0008 selection or any scale metric.
CR-DYN-0008 satisfied the frozen dependency and selected final_only, so the unchanged serial runner started the tiny scale arm.
The 155,840-parameter final_only-tiny arm completed exactly 20,000 updates and scored 12.669427 dB mean-frame PSNR and 0.553509 mean SSIM on 32 aligned held-out videos.
The 545,920-parameter final_only-small arm reached 9,882/20,000 structured updates and entered its periodic 10k evaluation; PID 929 remained alive.
The 545,920-parameter final_only-small arm completed exactly 20,000 updates and scored 13.396642 dB mean-frame PSNR and 0.580908 mean SSIM on 32 aligned held-out videos.
The 12,902,784-parameter final_only-large arm reached 11,207/20,000 structured updates with 99% A10 utilization; PID 929 remained alive.
